summary: Steep residential kerb with apartments and houses close by.

best_section.where: South kerb of Bishop Street at the low end, near the bend

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 12 m and homes 19 to 25 m away on the same side; overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; the flat low end has little room beside the lane.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park nearby; no camping convention.

flags: Steep: about 18% mean grade overall, 29% max
Only the first 25 m is near level
sun_shade: Tree cover from the east and south; open to the north.
